rows.message: ShopBot.showOrder builds a button whose callback data "order:details:with-the-full-delivery-address-and-the-courier-notes" is 66 bytes, over the 64 the bot platform takes: the message carrying it is refused
rows.evidence: the bot platform's API takes callback_data of 1-64 bytes; the data is written out
rows.fix: send a short key (an id, a code) and look the rest up when it comes back

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
